  normalisation >= 1.7e34 at the extreme corner; Lambda_2L >= 2.1 M_Pl at M_s = 1e13) with v_R in the seesaw window in
  85-100% of samples, but three loops fail at M_s = 3e12 (9% pass) and for a coherent GUT x1/2 spectrum (0.80-0.83);
  C1 + (6,2,2)_{2/3} is two-loop robust at M_s = 1e13 (tau >= 1.3e35, Lambda_2L >= 1.39) but fails the two-loop
  Landau test in 12% of the M_s = 3e12 samples, and its three-loop scale is below M_Pl,red in 35% (M_s = 1e13) to
  100% (M_s = 3e12, or GUT x1/2..x1) of the samples (section 12).  With the P831-type spectrum C1 + (6,2,2) loses the two-loop Landau test (0.95) and
  C1 + (8,1,3) the three-loop one (0.52) while tau still passes (section 6).  Neither was tested for realisability
  by K3 (that is R2-A's question).
